allowedDomains.title: Allowed domains
allowedDomains.description: Extra domains whose addresses are treated as internal, e.g. a partner organization. Exact domains (partner.org) or subdomain wildcards (*.example.org, which does not include example.org itself). gmail.com and googlemail.com are ignored. Default: empty.

cacheMinutes.title: Cache duration (minutes)
cacheMinutes.description: How long a folder's permissions are cached before being re-read. 0 disables caching. Default: 5.

colors.title: Level colors
colors.description: Banner background colors as #rrggbb. Text color is chosen automatically for WCAG AA contrast. The Unknown level is always gray and cannot be changed.

publicLinkSameAsDiscoverable.title: Treat Public (link) as severe as Public (discoverable)
publicLinkSameAsDiscoverable.description: When true, the Public (link) level uses the Public (discoverable) color and emphasis. Default: false.
